## Assessment for Delta Operations on Salmonids

Last updated: *`r format(Sys.Date(), "%B %d, %Y")`*

For more detailed data on salmonid conditions in the Delta see corresponding webpage on [SacPAS](https://www.cbr.washington.edu/sacramento/workgroups/salmon_monitoring.html).

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false
#| output: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(flextable)
library(magick)

project <- here()
source(here(project, 'source_code/salmon_code.R'), echo = FALSE)
source(here(project, 'source_code/text_updates.R'), echo = FALSE)
```

### Natural Winter-run Chinook

#### Juvenile Production Estimate

`r wr_jpe`

#### Current Status

*Delta Entry Timing* - Historically, as of `r format(Sys.Date()-1, "%b %d")`, `r if_else(is.na(delta_entry_wr), '0%', delta_entry_wr)` of length-at-date (LAD) winter-run have entered the Delta based on Knights Landing RST catch, `r if_else(is.na(delta_exit_wr), '0%', delta_exit_wr)` have exited the Delta based on Chipps Island Trawl Catch, and `r if_else(is.na(salvage_wr), '0%', salvage_wr)` of DNA confirmed winter-run have been salvaged.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-wr_timing_table
#| echo: false
#| tbl-cap: 'Average percent of annual emigrating population for unclipped LAD winter-run captured at monitoring locations and salvaged at Delta facilities for the past 10 years.'

flextable(wr_natural_timing) %>%
  #font(fontname = "Carlito", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 11, part = "all") %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  fit_to_width(max_width = 6.5)
```

*Red Bluff Diversion Dam Passage Estimate* - As of `r format(wr_rbdd_date, '%b %d')` estimated passage to date of LAD winter-run at Red Bluff Diversion is approximately `r wr_passage` million fish. *Note that outmigration timing overlaps with spring-run migrating fish, and true winter-run abundance likely differs from these estimates.*

*Delta Monitoring* - `r wr_entry_catch` `r wr_delta_catch` `r wr_exit_catch`

#### Annual Loss

`r wr_threshold` As of `r format(Sys.Date()-1, '%B %d')`, cumulative loss of genetically confirmed winter-run is `r wr_loss` or `r wr_perc` of the annual loss threshold. Cumulative loss in the past 7 days has been `r wr_7d`.

```{r}
#| label: fig-wr_loss
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| fig-cap: "Cumulative loss of natural-origin winter-run for WY 2026. Cumulative loss is based on genetically confirmed winter-run captured in salvage or length-at-date winter-run in which genetic confirmation was unable to be obtained."
#| fig-alt: "Line chart of cumulative loss of natural-origin winter-run Chinook salmon at Delta facilities where daily loss is tracked against the annual threshold"
#| fig-width: 10

knitr::include_graphics(paste0('https://www.cbr.washington.edu/sacramento/workgroups/include_gen/WY',wy,'/LossUnclip_1_DNAWinter_WY.png'))
```

#### STARS

The Delta STARS Model is an individual-based simulation model that predicts survival, travel time, and routing of juvenile salmon migrating through the Sacramento–San Joaquin River Delta. This model gives insight into survival and routing patterns of winter-run based on most current conditions.

`r stars_text`

```{r}
#| label: fig-stars_survival
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| fig-cap: "Estimated overall winter-run survival from Knights Landing to Chipps Island. Black line indicates the current water-year, and other colored lines correspond to past water years."
#| fig-alt: "Line chart of estimated overall winter-run survival probability from Knights Landing to Chipps Island where the current water year is compared to historical years"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
#| out-width: "100%"

knitr::include_graphics(paste0('https://www.cbr.washington.edu/sacramento/cohort/include_wrc/load_plot_02-1.png'))
```

### Natural-origin Central Valley Steelhead

#### Current Status

*Delta Entry Timing* - Historically, as of `r format(Sys.Date()-1, "%b %d")`, `r if_else(is.na(delta_entry_sh), '0%', delta_entry_sh)` of CCV steelhead have entered the Delta based on Knights Landing RST catch, `r if_else(is.na(delta_exit_sh), '0%', delta_exit_sh)` have exited the Delta based on Chipps Island Trawl Catch, and `r if_else(is.na(salvage_sh), '0%', salvage_sh)` have been salvaged.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-sh_timing_table
#| tbl-cap: 'Average percent of annual emigrating population for unclipped CCV steelhead captured at monitoring locations and salvaged at Delta facilities for the past 10 years.'
#| echo: false

flextable(sh_natural_timing) %>%
  #font(fontname = "Carlito", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 11, part = "all") %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  fit_to_width(max_width = 6.5)
```

*Delta Monitoring* - `r sh_entry_catch` `r sh_delta_catch` `r sh_exit_catch`

#### Annual Loss

As of `r format(Sys.Date()-1, '%B %d')`, cumulative loss of unclipped steelhead is `r sh_loss` or `r sh_perc` of the single-year incidental take limit (ITL). There is no annual loss threshold for natural steelhead. The single-year ITL is 5,294 juveniles or 2,319 juveniles as a 3-year rolling average (BiOp Table 184). Cumulative loss in the past 7 days has been `r sh_7d`.

```{r}
#| label: fig-sh_loss
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| fig-cap: "Cumulative loss of natural-origin steelhead for WY 2026. The 5,294 line represents the single-year incidental take limit (ITL), not a loss threshold."
#| fig-alt: "Line chart of cumulative loss of natural-origin steelhead at Delta facilities where daily loss is tracked against the single-year ITL of 5,294."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
#| out-width: "100%"

knitr::include_graphics(paste0('https://www.cbr.washington.edu/sacramento/workgroups/include_gen/WY',wy,'/LossUnclip_2_Stlhd_WY.png'))
```

### Hatchery-origin Central Valley Steelhead

#### Surrogate Releases

There have been a total of `r n_releases` releases totaling `r sh_stocked` steelhead in Water Year 2026. JPE for the hatchery releases as of today is `r sh_jpe` based on estimated survivals using forecasted water year types (see details in table below). The annual loss threshold, equal to 1% of the JPE, is currently `r sh_clipped_threshold_fmt`, but is subject to change with additional steelhead releases.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-sh_clipped_table
#| tbl-cap: 'Summary of steelhead hatchery releases in Water Year 2026. JPE calculated using hatchery-specific survival estimates to Delta entry from release location.'
#| echo: false

flextable(release_table_print) %>%
  #font(fontname = "Carlito", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 11, part = "all") %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  fit_to_width(max_width = 6.5)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-survival_estimates
#| tbl-cap: 'Hatchery-specific survival estimates used for JPE calculations.'
#| echo: false

# Create the survival estimates table 
survival_table <- data.frame(
  Hatchery = c("Coleman NFH", "Feather River Hatchery", "Nimbus Hatchery", "Mokelumne River Hatchery"),
  `Survival Estimate` = c("0.205 – 0.433", "0.09 – 0.45", "0.62 – 0.83", "0.25 – 0.33"),
  Source = c("Sandstrom et al. 2020", "Kurth 2013", "Brodsky et al. 2020", "Del Real et al. 2012"),
  check.names = FALSE
)

flextable(survival_table) %>%
  # font(fontname = "Carlito", part = "all") %>% # Removed for server compatibility
  fontsize(size = 11, part = "all") %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  align(align = "left", j = 1, part = "all") %>%
  align(align = "center", j = 2, part = "all") %>%
  align(align = "left", j = 3, part = "all") %>%
  fit_to_width(max_width = 6.5)
```

Total loss of hatchery-origin steelhead is `r sh_clipped_loss_total` or `r sh_clipped_perc_threshold` of the annual loss threshold. *Note that hatchery origin of salvaged fish cannot be determined at this time and salvage is based on the assumption of similar routing and survival probabilities of individual hatchery releases.*

```{r}
#| label: fig-sh_hatch_loss
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| fig-cap: "Cumulative loss of hatchery steelhead for WY 2026."
#| fig-alt: "Line chart of cumulative loss of hatchery-origin steelhead at Delta facilities where daily loss is tracked against the annual threshold"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
#| out-width: "100%"

knitr::include_graphics(paste0('https://www.cbr.washington.edu/sacramento/workgroups/include_gen/WY',wy,'/LossClipped_2_StlhdHatch_WY.png'))
```

### Spring-run Chinook

#### Current Status

*Delta Entry Timing* - Historically, as of `r format(Sys.Date()-1, "%b %d")`, `r if_else(is.na(delta_entry_sr), '0%', delta_entry_sr)` of LAD spring-run have entered the Delta based on Knights Landing RST catch, `r if_else(is.na(delta_exit_sr), '0%', delta_exit_sr)` have exited the Delta based on Chipps Island Trawl Catch, and `r if_else(is.na(salvage_sr), '0%', salvage_sr)` have been salvaged.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-sr_timing_table
#| tbl-cap: 'Average percent of annual emigrating population for LAD spring-run Chinook salmon captured at monitoring locations and salvaged at Delta facilities for the past 10 years.'
#| echo: false

flextable(sr_natural_timing) %>%
  #font(fontname = "Carlito", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 11, part = "all") %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  fit_to_width(max_width = 6.5)
```

*Red Bluff Diversion Dam Passage Estimate* - As of `r format(sr_rbdd_date, '%b %d')` estimated passage to date of LAD spring-run at Red Bluff Diversion is approximately `r sr_passage` million fish. *Note that outmigration timing overlaps with winter-run and fall-run outmigration, and true spring-run abundance likely differs from these estimates.*

*Delta Monitoring* - `r sr_entry_catch` `r sr_delta_catch` `r sr_exit_catch`

#### Spring-run Surrogate Releases

A total of `r total_sr_released_fmt` spring-run surrogate fish have been released in Water Year 2026, with an estimated Juvenile Production Estimate (JPE) of `r total_sr_jpe_fmt` fish entering the Delta. This includes `r sr_yearling_released_fmt` Coleman Late-Fall Run Chinook yearlings (JPE: `r sr_yearling_jpe_fmt`) released from Coleman National Fish Hatchery across `r coleman_n_groups` coded-wire tag groups, and `r sr_yoy_released_fmt` Feather River Hatchery Spring-Run young-of-year (JPE: `r sr_yoy_jpe_fmt`) across `r fr_n_groups` coded-wire tag groups. See details in table below.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-sr_surrogate_table
#| tbl-cap: 'Spring-run Chinook salmon surrogate releases: Coleman Late-Fall yearlings and Feather River Spring-Run young-of-year (production and experimental). ITL is 0.5% of each release group (BiOp Table 184).'
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

sr_surrogate_table_clean <- sr_surrogate_table_clean %>%
  mutate(`CWT Codes` = gsub("(([^,]+,){3})", "\\1\n", `CWT Codes`))

ft <- flextable(sr_surrogate_table_clean) %>%
  fontsize(size = 11, part = "all") %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  set_header_labels(
    `# of CWT Fish Released` = "CWT Released",
    `Confirmed Loss` = "Loss"
  )

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  ft <- ft %>% set_table_properties(layout = "autofit", width = 1)
} else {
  ft <- ft %>% 
    width(j = "CWT Codes", width = 1.8) %>%
    fit_to_width(max_width = 7.5)
}

ft
```

#### Annual Loss

The annual loss threshold (Action 5) is 1% of the JPE entering the Delta, tracked cumulatively but separately for yearlings and young-of-year. Yearling surrogates (Coleman Late-Fall): the threshold is `r sr_yearling_threshold_fmt` fish; as of `r format(Sys.Date()-1, '%B %d')`, cumulative loss is `r sr_yearling_loss_fmt` fish or `r sr_yearling_loss_perc` of the threshold. YOY surrogates (Feather River Spring-Run): the threshold is `r sr_yoy_threshold_fmt` fish; as of `r format(Sys.Date()-1, '%B %d')`, cumulative loss is `r sr_yoy_loss_fmt` fish or `r sr_yoy_loss_perc` of the threshold. The single-year incidental take limit (ITL) is 0.5% of the estimated number of each surrogate release group (BiOp Table 184). ITL status by release group: `r sr_itl_text`
